source: Elektron Digitone II User Manual, OS 1.12 (DOC10093enH): ch. 11–13, Appendix A, C, D.

conventions.slot: Knob position on the device page: 0–7 = A–H (A–D top row, E–H bottom row).
conventions.nrpn: MSB × 128 + LSB. MSB 1 and 3 = track channel, MSB 2 = FX CONTROL CH.
conventions.default: Coarse 0–127. defaultStated = true only when the manual names the default; otherwise a neutral value.
conventions.format: number(min, max, offset): shown value = clamp(raw + offset); bipolar: raw − 64; toggle: 0 = OFF; options: raw index, clamped to the last label; scaled: linear raw/127 onto min…max.

factoryChannels.fxControlChannelSource: not stated in the manual; catalog assumes OFF
factoryChannels.autoChannelSource: not stated in the manual; observed on the user's unit (OS 1.10D)
factoryChannels.note: Channels are 1-based here; DNChannelMap stores them 0-based.

channels.TRACK 1–16: Per-track channel for parameter CC/NRPN in and out; OFF disables. Default channels 1–16 (8.4).
channels.FX CONTROL CH: Channel for DELAY, REVERB, CHORUS, COMPRESSOR and master overdrive (in and out); OFF disables. Factory value not stated.
channels.AUTO CHANNEL: Addresses the active track; also used to record MIDI tracks from controllers. Factory value not stated; 10 observed on the user's unit.
channels.PROGRAM CHG IN CH: Channel listening for program change; AUTO = AUTO CHANNEL.
channels.PROGRAM CHG OUT CH: Channel sending program change on pattern change; AUTO = AUTO CHANNEL.

sync.PRG CH RECEIVE: Select patterns by incoming program change (0–127 = A01–H16).
sync.PRG CH SEND: Send program change when the pattern changes.
sync.screenshot: 13.4.1 screenshot shows CLOCK RECEIVE and TRANSPORT RECEIVE on, the rest off (not stated as defaults).

notes.0–15: Notes C0–D#1 trigger tracks 1–16 (with default channels).
notes.16–84: Notes E1–C7 play the active track chromatically; C5 = 60 = middle C.
